_comment: TC14 (2026-08-21) initial baseline, generated from a real, live, unscoped backlink_audit.py run against the actual repo (2026-08-22). Counts sum WRONG_TARGET+OVER_LIMIT+BLOCKED_TARGET+WRONG_ANCHOR_TEXT+DUPLICATE_LINK+DUPLICATE_SUBDOMAIN per family across all 5 subdomains -- the same blocking-status set check_backlink_compliance.py (the PR-scoped gate) uses. MISSING/SKIPPED/FAMILY_FALLBACK/COMPLIANT are never counted -- see check_backlink_regression.py module docstring. This is a known, honest starting point (pending TC15's staged backfill), not a target -- the ratchet only blocks further regression from here. Update by hand only when a regression is deliberately accepted, or after TC15 genuinely reduces a family's count (never auto-updated).
